name: p1-structured-output
title: sub: p1-structured-output
creator: codex
notes: S1 in progress on feat/p1d-structured-output. Ticket scope: the main chain moves to provider-native structured output + Pydantic schema + semantic validator + validation-error retry; _parse_json_response_impl becomes a legacy fallback; ContentPlan and friends get typed. Reconnaissance (2026-09-15): 25 _parse_json_response call sites across 13 agents, a second copy in services/llm_enrichment.py, zero with_structured_output anywhere, and three definitions of the same concept (api/generated Pydantic contract, state TypedDict, agent-side dicts). Production routes 13/15 TaskTypes to astron-code-latest (XUNFEI) and 4 of the 6 providers are OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so native structured-output support cannot be verified offline. Confirmed with the user before implementing: (1) capability declaration + degradation chain rather than all-native, (2) a new LLM-facing output model with normalisation rather than reusing the generated contract (too strict for a model: AwareDatetime / hex pattern / StrictStr would fail legal output), (3) this slice = scaffolding + one pilot (content_strategist ContentPlan). Red lines: no prompt text change (P1b snapshot stays at 0 drift), no edits under api/generated, no new dependency, _parse_json_response behaviour untouched. S1 landed on feat/p1d-structured-output (2026-09-15). Shipped: structured.py (capability declaration per provider, overridable via XHS_STRUCTURED_MODE_<PROVIDER>; degradation_path; validate_output doing schema only; StructuredOutputError), outputs.py (permissive ContentPlanOutput + normalize_content_plan), base.py _llm_structured / _structured_call / _llm_ainvoke(runnable, model_kwargs, raw unwrap), and the content_strategist pilot migration. Four things only surfaced once it ran: (1) the old drift guard nudged once and then accepted, so plumbing it through a fail-fast chain silently promoted an advisory check to a hard requirement -> added accept_last_valid (malformed payloads are still never returned; only validator refusals can be); (2) validate_output collapsed schema failure and validator refusal into one return value, which is the same trap -> it now does schema only and the caller runs the validator; (3) the NATIVE level was dead, because with_structured_output returns a validated instance and validate_output demanded a dict -> it now accepts a mapping or an instance of output_model; (4) the leniency branches in outputs.py were unreachable behind list[str] fields, and a model writing "a、b" for key_points would have been iterated character by character -> shape leniency moved into the model via mode=before validators and _as_list. Also fixed an existing defect found on the way: builder.py's content_strategist conditional edge omitted "__end__" from its path map while content_strategist_router returns it from its terminal guard, so any content_strategist failure crashed the graph with KeyError: '__end__' (fixed, plus tests/unit/graph/test_conditional_edge_wiring.py which compares every router's Literal return set against its path map both ways). Gates: pytest 2868 passed / 3 skipped, ruff check + format clean (491 files), mypy clean (199 files), P1b baseline drift 0, tool_runtime_gate OK.
